answer: Bind each agent to one hardware attestation, like a ferrous key forged for a single lock: a device can vouch for only one identity per epoch, and the attestation cannot be copied to another machine. On top of that, cluster submissions by behavior and timing, so a grove of look-alike accounts grown from one script is treated as one actor and shares one reward. A lone agent drifting in a lagoon of copies still earns, but a sybil farmer must buy real hardware per identity, turning a free duplication trick into a linear hardware cost.
